source.title: Closed operator inequalities and open problems

accepted.question_text: Let H be a complex Hilbert space and let B(H) be the C*-algebra of all bounded linear operators on H. Let N(H) be the class of all normal operators in B(H). For a relation R(S,X) on B(H) x B(H), call a proposition of the form "for every S in D(H) and every X in B(H), R(S,X)" closed in B(H) x B(H) when D(H) is exactly the set of all S in B(H) for which R(S,X) holds for every X in B(H). Determine the closure, in B(H) x B(H), of the operator inequality that holds for every S in N(H) and every X in B(H): ||S^2 X|| + ||X S^2|| >= 2||S X S||.

accepted.question_text: Let H be a complex Hilbert space and let B(H) be the C*-algebra of all bounded linear operators on H. Let I(H) be the class of invertible operators in B(H). Let C*S0(H) be the class of all invertible normal operators in B(H) whose spectra are contained in straight lines passing through the origin. Let R*U(H) be the class of all S in I(H) such that ||S X S^-1|| + ||S^-1 X S|| = 2||X|| for every X in B(H). For a relation R(S,X), call a proposition closed in B(H) x B(H) when its operator class is exactly the set of all S in B(H) for which R(S,X) holds for every X in B(H). Determine the closures of both of the following operator inequalities: first, for every S in R*U(H) and every X in B(H), ||S X S^-1 + S^-1 X S|| <= 2||X||; second, for every S in C*S0(H) union R*U(H) and every X in B(H), ||S X S^-1 + S^-1 X S|| <= ||S* X S^-1 + S^-1 X S*||, where S* denotes the adjoint of S.
accepted.context_brief: Closures of R*U and C*S0 inequalities

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/5851784. Local shell fetching failed with network_or_dns_failure because curl could not resolve zbmath.org in the sandbox. Local project shard metadata identified the same resolver record as 'Closed operator inequalities and open problems' with DOI 10.7153/mia-14-12. Exact-title and DOI web recovery found the Ele-Math article page and confirmed the direct PDF https://files.ele-math.com/articles/mia-14-12.pdf as the readable full-text source for the same work.

Mapped the PDF title page and section hierarchy: 1 Introduction, 2 On the Corach-Porta-Recht Inequality, 3 Closed Operator Inequalities and Invertible Self-adjoint Operators, 4 Closed Operator Inequalities and Invertible Normal Operators, 5 Closed Operator Inequalities and Unitary Operators, and 6 Open Problems. The notation and closed-proposition definition are on page 1; the likely open-problem region is section 6 on pages 7-8.
Sections 1-5 provide definitions, notation, previous inequalities, and characterizations but no explicit open-problem blocks.

Section 6 yielded three explicit candidates: Problem 1 asks for the closure of inequality (17), Problem 2 asks for the closure of inequality (18), and Problem 3 asks for the closure of each of inequalities (19) and (20).
Could not produce a fully self-contained accepted rewrite because the source uses CS(H) in inequality (17) without an explicit definition in the readable primary text.
Expanded the Problem 2 statement with the definitions of B(H), N(H), and closed proposition, and restated inequality (18) directly.
Expanded Problem 3 into one self-contained question covering both inequalities (19) and (20), using source-supported descriptions of C*S0(H) and R*U(H).
No duplicate candidate was found for Problem 1.
No duplicate candidate was found for Problem 2.

Problem 3 contains two related closure subquestions in one source problem block; they were retained as one canonical extracted question to preserve the source grouping and avoid a potential artificial split.
